newsitem.title: JAPAN: Idemitsu to sharply raise Dec wholesale prices.
newsitem.headline: Idemitsu to sharply raise Dec wholesale prices.

text.p: Refiner Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd said on Thursday it would raise the wholesale price of its oil products by 1,600 yen per kilolitre, effective December 1.
The steep increase, for the second consecutive month, reflects strong international crude prices and the weaker yen against the dollar, Idemitsu said in a statement.

Following the rise, the wholesale price for gasoline will be 91.8 yen per litre including tax, and 37.8 yen per litre for kerosene and gas oil. Kerosene and gas oil are not taxed at the wholesale stage.
On Wednesday, refiner Nippon Oil Co Ltd said it would raise the wholesale price of its oil products by 1,400 yen per kilolitre for December shipments.
Major Japanese refiners review their wholesale product prices on a monthly basis, taking into account international crude prices, oil product prices and currency market rates.
